evidence: The effective thickness of the synthesized coatings was determined ellipsometrically on a laboratory setup with a He–Ne laser (λ = 632.8 nm) designed according to the PCSA (polarizer–compensator–sample–analyzer) scheme with a fixed compensator. The surface morphology of the samples was examined on a Solver P47 Pro scanning probe microscope (NT-MDT, Russia) in air by using atomic-force microscopy (AFM) methods in the contact mode.
